mu_name_from: MuMain's MONSTER_DEATH_GORGON = 35, drawn out of the Gorgon's own model (MONSTER_MODEL_GORGON, Monster12.bmd). The client's name is 데쓰 고르곤 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:13897-13906). OpenMU's Version075 LostTower.cs:690-721 names number 35 'Death Gorgon' at level 64 with 6000 health, 200-210 damage, 130 defense, MoveRange 3, AttackRange 1, ViewRange 7, AttackDelay 2000, MonsterSkill (150) -- WebZen's one-in-five Flame of Evil, not built yet. 61 spots: 11 on Lost Tower 6, 50 on 7.
mesh_from: Monster12 a second time, as the Hell Hound is Monster02 a second time.
monster_from: The MONSTER_DEATH_GORGON branch: `c->Object.Scale = 1.3f; c->Weapon[0].Type = MODEL_CRESCENT_AXE; c->Weapon[1].Type = MODEL_CRESCENT_AXE; c->Object.BlendMesh = 1; c->Object.BlendMeshLight = 1.f; c->Level = 2;`.
hands_from: MODEL_CRESCENT_AXE is Item/Axe09.bmd, cooked for the Cyclops. The bones are the Gorgon's: `case MODEL_GORGON: c->Weapon[0].LinkBone = 30; c->Weapon[1].LinkBone = 39` (ZzzCharacter.cpp:12037-12040), knife_gdf and hand_bofdgne01.
glow_from: The Gorgon's: BlendMesh 1, its eyes added and their light rolled each frame (Gorgon01's glow_from).
effects_from: Level 2 is what MoveCharacterVisual's MODEL_GORGON case reads (ZzzCharacter.cpp:6061-6076): every frame ten BITMAP_FIRE on random bones, and AddTerrainLight of (1, 0.2, 0) times the rolled Luminosity, two tiles. Drawn in game/fx/shadow_stars.h, ours and subtle as the Shadows' (the user's asks of 2026-10-01): a few faint embers off random joints rather than ten a frame, and a faint orange light on the nearest two.
sounds_from: The Gorgon's model and so the Gorgon's five (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3473-3482). Wired as deathgorgon_*, gorgon_*'s files.
